subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a public ContextEngine contract in which enabling `turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` can start a second same-session `maintain()` while the timed-out invocation is still running?
rationale: The host can fence only host-owned state. Choosing between preserved serialization and plugin-owned re-entrancy changes the compatibility promise for installed context-engine plugins and cannot be resolved mechanically from the patch.

options.title: Preserve serialized maintenance
options.body: Keep the timeout’s liveness benefit but prevent another same-session maintenance invocation until the abandoned worker settles or an owner-approved cancellation mechanism exists.

options.title: Accept plugin re-entrancy
options.body: Adopt the documented contract and require context-engine plugins to make same-session maintain operations idempotent or internally serialized when users opt in to the timeout.

recommendation.title: Preserve serialized maintenance
recommendation.body: Keep the timeout’s liveness benefit but prevent another same-session maintenance invocation until the abandoned worker settles or an owner-approved cancellation mechanism exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor authored the proposed timeout and the explicit ContextEngine contract documentation; broader current-main ownership could not be established from the unavailable local history inspection.
